name: kater-dev-tools
install: chmod +x .cursor/hooks/fetch-cursor-artifacts.sh scripts/check_cursor_artifacts.sh scripts/sync-chefgroep-skills.sh 2>/dev/null; CHEFGROEP_SKILLS_REPO=github.com/GroepOnline/chefgroep-skills ./scripts/sync-chefgroep-skills.sh; .cursor/hooks/fetch-cursor-artifacts.sh --write-cache; if [ -f scripts/generate_cursor_index.py ]; then python3 scripts/generate_cursor_index.py; fi; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv sync --dev

terminals.name: kater-gateway
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run kater serve --profile core --no-proxy --host 127.0.0.1
terminals.description: Kater MCP gateway (core profile, no proxy). Ports: MCP SSE :9090, REST/dashboard/health :9091, WebSocket :9092.
